parameters.name: DbType
parameters.description: The database type. For more information about valid values, see [DbType parameter description](~~198106~~).

parameters.name: EnvType
parameters.description:
The environment type. Valid values:
- **product**: production environment
- **dev**: development environment
- **pre**: pre-release environment
- **test**: test environment
- **sit**: SIT environment
- **uat**: UAT environment
- **pet**: stress testing environment
- **stag**: STAG environment

parameters.name: InstanceSource
parameters.description:
The instance source. Valid values:

- **PUBLIC_OWN**: self-managed instance connected over the Internet
- **RDS**: ApsaraDB RDS instance
- **ECS_OWN**: self-managed instance on ECS
- **VPC_IDC**: self-managed instance in a VPC-connected IDC

parameters.name: InstanceState
parameters.description:
The instance status. Valid values:
- **NORMAL**: Normal.
- **DISABLE**: Disabled.

parameters.name: NetType
parameters.description:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:
- **CLASSIC**: classic network
- **VPC**: VPC network

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The value cannot exceed 100.

parameters.name: RealLoginUserUid
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user who actually calls the API.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
